metadata.title: Rationally Null-homologous Floer Simple Knot
metadata.abstract: We prove that every rationally null-homologous Floer simple knot in a closed, oriented, irreducible three-manifold with nonzero Thurston norm is unknotted. The proof combines a cut-and-reglue comparison for extremal Floer groups with Binns's theorem on Floer-minimal knots in balanced sutured manifolds.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 非零Thurston范数下Floer simple结的平凡性
analysis.workSummary: 证明闭定向不可约三流形中，若Thurston范数非零，则每个有理零同调Floer simple结都是unknotted。证明结合extremal Floer群的cut-and-reglue比较与Binns关于平衡sutured流形中Floer-minimal结的定理。
analysis.breakthrough: 在指定三流形类中用Floer最小性识别平凡结。
analysis.limitations: 闭、定向、不可约、非零Thurston范数和有理零同调均是前提，不能推广到全部Floer simple结。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
